items.title: @GoogleDeepMind：Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmast
items.abstract_or_text: Games have been an important testbed for our AI research for over 15 years. 🎮 From mastering Atari to reaching Grandmaster in StarCraft II, they have driven some of our biggest AI breakthroughs. Our work with SIMA taught agents how to understand 3D worlds, but learning to navigate real human dynamics takes a living, persistent universe. Through our research partnership with @FenrisCreations, we’re exploring how to tackle open challenges in AI: 🔵 Continual learning to acquire new skills without forgetting past knowledge. 🔵 Deep memory systems that store and retrieve information far beyond today’s context windows. 🔵 Long-horizon planning over weeks, months, or years. 🔵 Multi-agent dynamics spanning cooperation, negotiation, economics, and emergent behaviors. Our long-term goal is to use AI to discover entirely new gameplay experiences in partnership with game developers – making games more accessible and personalized – while applying what we've learned to problems in the real world and scientific discovery. Find out more →

items.abstract_zh: 15 年多来，游戏一直是我们 AI 研究的重要试验场。🎮 从掌握 Atari，到在《星际争霸 II》中达到大师级水平，游戏推动了我们一些最重大的 AI 突破。我们与 SIMA 的工作教会智能体理解三维世界，但学习应对真实的人类动态需要一个鲜活、持续存在的宇宙。 通过与 @FenrisCreations 的研究合作，我们正在探索如何应对 AI 中的开放挑战： 🔵 持续学习，在不遗忘既有技能的情况下获得新技能。 🔵 深度记忆系统，存储和检索远超当今上下文窗口的信息。 🔵 跨越数周、数月或数年的长期规划。 🔵 涵盖合作、协商、经济活动和涌现行为的多智能体动态。 我们的长期目标是与游戏开发者合作，用 AI 发现全新的游戏体验，让游戏更易获取、更具个性化，同时把所学应用于现实世界的问题和科学发现。了解更多 →

items.abstract_or_text: 🚢 Marin 535B-A23B started training this week! As usual, the whole process is open. Voyage plan: pretraining (80%) + midtraining (20%) on 18.75T tokens on 11 x GB200 NVL72 for ~3 months (2.7e24 FLOPs). Post-training will follow. This is by far our biggest run, so definitely expecting the unexpected.

items.abstract_or_text: ## Overview This version marks the beginning of consistent semantic versioning for `llama.cpp`. The main goal is to make the job of downstream projects and users simpler when deciding which version of `llama.cpp`/`ggml` to distribute and use. The new version tags of the format `vX.Y.Z` will mark "stable" versions of `llama.cpp`. The usual `b[NUM]` tags remain as before - created on almost every commit to the `master` branch. The `b` tags can be considered as "nightly" or "dev" versions with the…
items.summary_zh: ggml-org/llama.cpp 发布 v0.2.0，开始采用稳定语义化版本：`vX.Y.Z` 面向下游发行与一般用户，`b[NUM]` 继续作为高频 nightly/dev 版本；同步带来多后端、模型、服务端与发布产物改进。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 嵌入 llama.cpp 的应用和发行维护者终于可据稳定标签制定升级与打包策略，避免将高频开发构建直接用于常规部署。该版本也改善了多平台推理、模型加载和认证服务的可用性。
items.abstract_zh: 发布说明表示，v0.2.0 开始为 `llama.cpp` 建立持续的语义化版本体系。`vX.Y.Z` 标签表示发布节奏较慢、推荐下游分发者和一般用户使用的稳定版本；`b[NUM]` 标签仍会几乎随 `master` 的每次提交生成，提供最新功能，面向开发者和技术用户，但稳定性可能较低。发布资产中的 `nightly-tag.txt` 用于标示对应 nightly。自 v0.1.2 以来的变更包括：扩展 Metal、Vulkan、OpenCL、SYCL、WebGPU、CUDA 等后端支持与修复；增加多种模型和多模态能力；优化量化、KV cache、Flash Attention 与内存使用；为 server 增加路由、延迟加载、睡眠期间 metrics 访问等能力；认证启用时将 models endpoints 设为私有；并为签名发布产物增加 attestation。

items.abstract_or_text: The most important new feature in this release is multistate sampling. ReplicaExchangeSampler and ExpandedEnsembleSampler implement algorithms for sampling a collection of thermodynamic states that differ in temperature, pressure, or Hamiltonian. They are useful for a variety of purposes, such as using high temperature to accelerate transitions or computing free energy differences along an alchemical transition. There are several other enhancements in this release that are also significant. - Cu…
items.summary_zh: openmm/openmm 发布 8.6.0，引入 `ReplicaExchangeSampler` 与 `ExpandedEnsembleSampler` 多状态采样；同时为长程修正缓存、ML/MM 的 `PythonForce` 子集执行和多种 barostat 增加性能与建模能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 分子模拟与自由能计算工作流可直接实施温度、压力或 Hamiltonian 的多状态采样。频繁改变全局参数的模拟，以及只对部分粒子调用 `PythonForce` 的 ML/MM 项目，可能获得显著加速。
items.abstract_zh: 发布说明称，8.6.0 最重要的新功能是多状态采样。`ReplicaExchangeSampler` 和 `ExpandedEnsembleSampler` 实现对一组热力学状态进行采样，这些状态可在温度、压力或 Hamiltonian 上不同；其用途包括通过高温加速状态转变，以及沿炼金转变计算自由能差。`CustomNonbondedForce` 可缓存长程修正系数，在频繁修改全局参数的模拟中，例如使用新的多状态采样器时，可能大幅提升速度。`PythonForce` 可限制为仅作用于系统中部分粒子，主要用于 ML/MM 模拟并可显著加速。`MonteCarloBarostat`、`MonteCarloAnisotropicBarostat` 与 `MonteCarloMembraneBarostat` 现在可逐粒子缩放，而非将分子作为刚体缩放；`MonteCarloFlexibleBarostat` 已具备该选项，并新增计算应力张量的函数。
